title: Children and Builders
program_note:
Of the line from Torah “And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children,” Rabbi Elazar said: “Torah scholars increase peace in the world, as it is written: ‘And all your children shall be students of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of your children.’ Do not read ‘your children’ (banayikh), but ‘your builders’ (bonayikh).”

This text seemed especially apt for a memorial composition for Abner Goldstine, one-time president of Sinai Temple.  It is set for baritone and piano.

David S. Lefkowitz
16 May, 2025
Los Angeles, CA
